meaning: Malformed/corrupt ELF binary, per fapolicyd's own magic-based classification — denied outright regardless of trust.
ELF shared library (.so) — gated by trust=1, checked ahead of executables since a typical executable links a dozen or more of these.
Shell script — allowed unconditionally (perm=any), no trust gate.
Compiled Python bytecode (.pyc) — gated by trust=1.
Named set of ~23 script/bytecode MIME types (Perl, PHP, Ruby, Lua, JavaScript, R, Tcl, OCaml, Java, awk, and more) — referenced by 70-trusted-lang.rules and 91-deny-lang.rules.
